description: Studio iMac CPU, memory, disk and network metrics from the macOS node exporter.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the iMac last booted.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Average non-idle CPU across all logical cores over the last five minutes.

panels.title: RAM in use
panels.description: Active, wired and compressed memory as a share of installed RAM. macOS can reclaim inactive memory.

panels.title: Data volume used
panels.description: Share of the main APFS data volume unavailable for new writes.

panels.title: Logical CPU cores
panels.description: Logical processors reported by the macOS node exporter.

panels.title: Installed RAM
panels.description: Physical memory reported by the iMac.

panels.title: Data volume free
panels.description: Space available for new writes on the main APFS data volume.

title: Studio iMac
